name: Subsonic / Navidrome
author: meofishes
description: Your own music server: Navidrome, Airsonic, Gonic, Ampache, LMS, Jellyfin (with its Subsonic plugin) — anything that speaks the Subsonic API. Search, home (recent and random albums), playlists, artist radio, lyrics and covers; plays straight from the server. Scrobbles back so the server's play counts stay right.

settings.label: Server address
settings.description: For example https://music.example.com (try https://demo.navidrome.org with demo / demo)

settings.label: Password
settings.description: Sent as a salted token, never in clear text.

settings.label: Max bitrate when transcoding (kbps, 0 = no limit)
